product: Genie visualizations in Microsoft Teams replies (Public Preview)
tagline: When a Genie response includes a chart, the visualization now appears as an image in the Microsoft Teams reply.
what_it_does: When a Genie response includes a chart, the visualization now appears as an image in the Microsoft Teams reply. Beta This feature is in Beta. Account admins can manage access to this feature from the account console Previews page.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: When a Genie response includes a chart, the visualization now appears as an image in the Microsoft Teams reply.
limitations: Triggering actions in Databricks from Teams
key_takeaway: When a Genie response includes a chart, the visualization now appears as an image in the Microsoft Teams reply.
